defs.def: when a volcano erupts or burning rocks, smoke, etc. erupt or are erupted, the burning rocks, etc. are thrown out from the volcano （火山）爆发；（岩浆、烟等）喷出

ex.s: What caused the disappearance of dinosaurs: 1 a huge meteorite hitting Earth 2 ash and gas from erupting volcanoes 3 disease Among the many unsolved mysteries about dinosaurs, what really interests me is their disappearance.
ex.t: 恐龙灭绝的原因： 1 一颗巨大的陨石撞击地球 2 火山喷发产生的灰烬和气体 3 疾病 在关于恐龙的许多未解之谜中，真正让我感兴趣的是它们究竟是如何灭绝的。

ex.s: The couple who live next to us volunteered to help after the volcano erupted.
ex.t: 住在我们隔壁的那对夫妇在火山喷发后自愿去帮忙。

ex.s: When a volcano erupts, , volcanic ash and even rocks escape through a large opening at the top.
ex.t: 当火山喷发时，火山灰甚至岩石都会从顶部一个巨大的开口中喷涌而出。

ex.s: His classic novel The Last Days of Pompeii imagines life in the ancient Roman city of Pompeii in the year 79, when Mount Vesuvius erupted.
ex.t: 他的经典小说《庞贝末日》想象了公元 79 年古罗马庞贝城的生活，当时维苏威火山正在喷发。

ex.s: People in Pompei were not aware of the signs before the volcano erupted, and the city disasters in the future?
ex.t: 庞贝人对火山喷发前的征兆毫无察觉，未来的城市灾难呢？

ex.s: The awkward moment ended with the class erupting into laughter.
ex.t: 为了美术O-level考试，我需要交一幅油画作品。

defs.def: to start happening, suddenly and violently 突然发生；爆发
to suddenly express your feelings very strongly, especially by shouting loudly 突然发出（尤指叫喊）
to suddenly appear on your skin 斑点等
